prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen System Audio Preview: Displays an ambient sound toggle and loading info badge on the waiting screen to engage users while waiting.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "style": "calm", "text": "Play relaxing waiting music"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Launcher Screen: Adds a dedicated post-onboarding launch checklist screen showing how to summon and minimize your pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_launcher"], "new_pet_launcher": {"headline": "Launch & Control Your Pet", "body": "Learn how to summon, dock, and interact with your new desktop pet anytime.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "plain", "text": "Double click system tray to hide/show pet"}]}}
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Status Banner: Adds a live step-by-step desktop environment loading checklist on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "subtle", "text": "Initialising pet behavior engine..."}]}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Pet Care & Safety Summary Screen: Adds a pet account safety summary screen explaining device sync and backup recovery at the end of onboarding.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_account_safety_summary"], "new_account_safety_summary": {"headline": "Your Pet Companion is Saved", "body": "Your pet state is automatically backed up to your account.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "highlight", "text": "Auto-Sync Active"}]}}
4: [choose_path, reorder] Path First Story Second Flow Order: Reorders the onboarding by putting path choice screen right at the start before the intro story.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
5: [adoption, new_flow] Adoption Pledge New Flow Step: Adds a pre-adoption pledge screen before photo upload where users select their pet's primary behavior trait.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_pledge", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_pledge": {"headline": "Make a Companion Pledge", "body": "Select how your pet should behave on your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose", "text": "Playful, Calm, Focused"}]}}
6: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Screen Redesign: Redesigns the app intro story screen with a dynamic mascot preview component.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Your new desktop friend awaits!"}]}}
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Readiness Notification Switch: Adds a system alert toggle component on the waiting screen notifying users when pet rendering finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "style": "emphasis", "text": "Desktop Alert Ready"}]}}
8: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Visibility Quick Guide Flow: Adds an interactive desktop pet visibility screen explaining how to toggle pet overlay on/off.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_visibility_guide"], "new_visibility_guide": {"headline": "Desktop Visibility & Overlay", "body": "Easily hide your pet during presentations or work.", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "style": "rounded", "text": "Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+P to hide pet"}]}}
9: [choose_path, hint] App Intro Path Discovery Hint: Adds a subtle hint banner on the intro story screen reassuring users that pet selection can be changed later.
   config: {"story": {"hint": "Don't worry, you can customize or change your pet companion anytime later in settings."}}
